headline: Silver Plus is the unique savings fit and the open-savings-before-closing order is documented, but the gold closure leaves the free-text closure reason at a hidden default, so an agent that records a reason fails.

issues.summary: close_bank_account_7392 stores its optional free-text 'reason' argument in accounts[...].closure_reason. Gold omits it, so the record gets the hidden default 'Customer requested closure'. No document says which reason to pass or to leave it out, so an agent that records a sensible reason produces a different DB state.
evidence: tools.py close_bank_account_7392 signature: reason: str = "Customer requested closure"; body: account["closure_reason"] = reason
unlock output: "reason: string (optional) - The reason for closing the account" (default value not shown)
doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_005: "3. Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account." (no reason value anywhere in the KB)
replay: reason='Customer wants to consolidate checking accounts' gives a different hash; reason='Customer requested closure' gives the same hash
issues.why_it_matters: Passing a reason (e.g. 'Customer wants to consolidate checking accounts') is a reasonable, even diligent, use of an offered parameter, but it fails DB grading. Only omitting the argument, or guessing the exact default string, matches gold.
issues.suggested_fix: Exclude closure_reason from the hashed state, or have the closure doc state the exact reason string and put it in the gold call.

solution_check: The Blue checking (opened 11/04/2025) is 10 days old, so closing Green (07/17/2025, $0.00) first would leave no checking account at least 14 days old (doc_(general)_002). The ordering is documented. Green is 120 days old, past the 60-day window, so no early-closure fee applies. Savings criteria: 12-15 withdrawals, relationship bonus, $2,500-4,000, daily compounding, ATM rebates, goals tracking. Only Silver Plus meets them all (15 withdrawals, 0.025% bonus, $2,500 minimum, daily, ATM rebates 25, goals tracking Yes). Silver allows 10 withdrawals (this user has no Platinum card), Green 8, Bronze 6, and Gold needs $10k. The gold replays cleanly.
prior_note: The prior review rated this clean under a scorer that ignored closure_reason. Under upstream exact-hash grading, the free-text reason is compared.
notes: doc_(general)_005 lists 'Notice period: 3 days' for mid-tier checking without defining it; gold closes immediately, and no tool models a notice period. waive_early_closure_fee=false passed explicitly gives the same hash as gold (verified).
